funding.value: Five years of guaranteed support (stipend, tuition remission, health-services fee and insurance subsidy) for incoming doctoral students.
funding.quote: Incoming doctoral students receive five years of guaranteed financial support, including a stipend, tuition remission, a health-services fee, and a health-insurance subsidy.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a good undergraduate mathematics background; no master's is asked for.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a good background in undergraduate mathematics, regardless of their majors.

notes: The program page still shows a January 1, 2026 deadline; the Graduate School explorer gives 01/01/2027. Applied Mathematics is a separate PhD (deadline 12/08/2026 in the explorer) not saved here.
